title: Analytic: plane wave on a PEC cylinder, Bessel-series scattering (FDFD, E_z, TFSF)
description:
A +x plane wave (plane_wave_tfsf, E_z, 1 V/m, box +-0.6 um around the cylinder) hits a perfectly conducting cylinder of radius a = 0.4 um (pec_domain, staircased: 40 cells per radius) in a CPML-bounded vacuum box; stationary FDFD solve at lambda0 = 1 um (k a = 2.51; ~1.1e5 unknowns, scipy SuperLU). A far_field box +-0.75 um lies in the scattered field outside the TFSF box.
Analytic (E_z on a PEC cylinder, exp(+j omega t)): a_n = J_n(k a) / H_n^(2)(k a); scattered E_s = -E0 sum_n (-j)^n eps_n a_n H_n^(2)(k r) cos(n phi) (eps_0 = 1, eps_n = 2); far-field pattern |a_0 + 2 sum a_n cos(n phi)|^2; scattering width sigma = (4 / k) sum_n eps_n |a_n|^2, so P_sca = E0^2 / (2 eta0) sigma. Series to n = 6 (J_n, Y_n by upward recurrence in the parameters; |a_7| < 1e-4).
Far field tab: em.far vs the dashed Bessel-series pattern (both peak-normalised; forward lobe at 0 deg).
Derived values tab: P_sca (angle integral of the far-field power) vs E0^2 sigma / (2 eta0), back_forward (peak-normalised power at 180 deg; the reference assumes the peak at 0 deg), E_fwd / E_back (|E_z| of the scattered field in one cell at r = 0.85 um, phi = 0 / 180 deg) vs |E_s|.
Field tab: ez_abs (total field inside the TFSF box, scattered field outside).
Expected agreement: ~1-3 % (staircased circle, about a quarter cell of effective-radius error), back_forward the most sensitive; to be confirmed by a first run (a dx sweep 20 / 10 / 5 nm shows the staircase convergence).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the solve (100 cells)

parameters.name: x_cyl
parameters.description: cylinder centre x (a cell centre: symmetric staircase)

parameters.name: r_prb
parameters.description: probe distance from the cylinder axis (85 cells; outside the TFSF and far-field boxes)

parameters.name: half_cell
parameters.description: half width of the one-cell derived-value squares

parameters.name: J2a
parameters.description: J_2(k a) (recurrence Z_{n+1} = (2n / x) Z_n - Z_{n-1})

parameters.name: cR0
parameters.description: Re a_0 H_0^(2)(k r) (H = J - j Y)

parameters.name: Sf_R
parameters.expression: cR0 + 2*(cI1 - cR2 - cI3 + cR4 + cI5 - cR6)
parameters.description: Re sum_n eps_n (-j)^n a_n H_n^(2)(k r) at phi = 0 (forward)

parameters.name: Sf_I
parameters.expression: cI0 + 2*(-cR1 - cI2 + cR3 + cI4 - cR5 - cI6)
parameters.description: Im of that sum at phi = 0

parameters.name: Sb_R
parameters.expression: cR0 + 2*(-cI1 - cR2 + cI3 + cR4 - cI5 - cR6)
parameters.description: Re of that sum at phi = 180 deg (cos(n phi) = (-1)^n)

parameters.name: Sb_I
parameters.expression: cI0 + 2*(cR1 - cI2 - cR3 + cI4 + cR5 - cI6)
parameters.description: Im of that sum at phi = 180 deg

parameters.name: E_back_ref
parameters.description: analytic scattered |E_z| at r_prb, phi = 180 deg [V/m]

parameters.name: F0_R
parameters.expression: ar0 + 2*(ar1 + ar2 + ar3 + ar4 + ar5 + ar6)
parameters.description: Re of the forward far-field amplitude sum eps_n a_n (= sum eps_n |a_n|^2: optical theorem)

parameters.name: F0_I
parameters.expression: ai0 + 2*(ai1 + ai2 + ai3 + ai4 + ai5 + ai6)

parameters.name: Fb_R
parameters.expression: ar0 + 2*(-ar1 + ar2 - ar3 + ar4 - ar5 + ar6)

parameters.name: Fb_I
parameters.expression: ai0 + 2*(-ai1 + ai2 - ai3 + ai4 - ai5 + ai6)

parameters.name: back_forward_ref
parameters.description: far-field power at 180 deg over that at 0 deg

parameters.name: sigma_sca
parameters.description: scattering width sigma = (4 / k) sum eps_n |a_n|^2 [m]

parameters.name: P_sca_ref
parameters.description: scattered power per unit length [W/m]: incident intensity E0^2 / (2 eta0) times sigma

analytic_curves.name: bessel_pattern
analytic_curves.expression: (ar0 + 2*(ar1*cos(angle) + ar2*cos(2*angle) + ar3*cos(3*angle) + ar4*cos(4*angle) + ar5*cos(5*angle) + ar6*cos(6*angle)))**2 + (ai0 + 2*(ai1*cos(angle) + ai2*cos(2*angle) + ai3*cos(3*angle) + ai4*cos(4*angle) + ai5*cos(5*angle) + ai6*cos(6*angle)))**2
